headline: Spanish 101 Master
threshold: Apply beginner grammar across reading, recall, listening, typing, speaking and writing; check and revisit errors in familiar situations.

lessons.title: Introduce a classmate
lessons.objective: Introduce a classmate: Say each Spanish vowel clearly: a, e, i, o, u.

words.es: Soy de Perú y estudio música.
words.en: I am from Peru and I study music.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Una compañera nueva with a patient classmate. Practice introduce a classmate. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

grammar.focus: Say each Spanish vowel clearly: a, e, i, o, u. Hola has a silent h; gracias and por favor keep greetings polite.

examples.es: Hola, soy Elena.
examples.en: Hello, I am Elena.

examples.es: Soy de Perú y estudio música.
examples.en: I am from Peru and I study music.

lessons.title: Pack for a first class
lessons.objective: Pack for a first class: A noun has grammatical gender.

words.es: Necesito una mochila para la clase.
words.en: I need a backpack for class.

words.es: El cuaderno está en la mesa.
words.en: The notebook is on the table.

words.es: La silla está cerca de la puerta.
words.en: The chair is near the door.

words.es: Pongo el libro en la mochila.
words.en: I put the book in the backpack.
Now I have everything for studying.

words.es: Hay una mesa en la clase.
words.en: There is a table in the classroom.

words.es: El libro está en la mesa.
words.en: The book is on the table.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Antes de salir with a patient classmate. Practice pack for a first class. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

grammar.focus: A noun has grammatical gender. Learn its article with it: el libro, la mesa. Un and una mean a or an; gender is not a rule about the object itself.

examples.es: Necesito una mochila para la clase.
examples.en: I need a backpack for class.

examples.es: El cuaderno está en la mesa.
examples.en: The notebook is on the table.

lessons.title: Prepare materials for a group
lessons.objective: Prepare materials for a group: Usually add -s after a vowel and -es after a consonant.

words.es: Hay cuatro estudiantes en el grupo.
words.en: There are four students in the group.

words.es: Solo hay dos libros en la mesa.
words.en: There are only two books on the table.

words.es: Las mochilas están debajo de las sillas.
words.en: The backpacks are under the chairs.

words.es: Los lápices están cerca de los cuadernos.
words.en: The pencils are near the notebooks.

words.es: Los libros son para la clase.
words.en: The books are for the class.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Cuatro compañeros with a patient classmate. Practice prepare materials for a group. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

grammar.focus: Usually add -s after a vowel and -es after a consonant. Articles also become plural: el libro → los libros; la ciudad → las ciudades.

examples.es: Hay cuatro estudiantes en el grupo.
examples.en: There are four students in the group.

examples.es: Necesitamos cuatro libros.
examples.en: We need four books.

lessons.title: Identity or current condition?
lessons.objective: Identity or current condition?: Use ser for identity, origin and characteristics.

words.en: They are happy to help her.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Una compañera cansada with a patient classmate. Practice identity or current condition?. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

grammar.focus: Use ser for identity, origin and characteristics. Present forms: soy, eres, es, somos, son. A profession normally has no un or una after ser.

examples.es: Marta es estudiante de medicina.
examples.en: Marta is a medical student.

examples.es: Hoy está cansada.
examples.en: Today she is tired.

lessons.title: Describe a room accurately
lessons.objective: Describe a room accurately: Hay means there is or there are.

words.es: Hay una sala nueva en la escuela.
words.en: There is a new room at the school.

words.es: Hay una computadora y dos ventanas.
words.en: There is a computer and two windows.

words.es: La computadora está sobre la mesa.
words.en: The computer is on the table.

words.es: Las sillas están cerca de la puerta.
words.en: The chairs are near the door.

words.es: No hay libros en esta sala.
words.en: There are no books in this room.

words.es: La biblioteca está en el otro piso.
words.en: The library is on the other floor.

words.es: Hay una biblioteca en la escuela.
words.en: There is a library at the school.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Una sala diferente with a patient classmate. Practice describe a room accurately. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

grammar.focus: Hay means there is or there are. Its form does not change for one or many. Use hay to introduce something; use estar to locate a known thing.

examples.es: Hay una sala nueva en la escuela.
examples.en: There is a new room at the school.

examples.es: Hay una computadora y dos ventanas.
examples.en: There is a computer and two windows.

lessons.title: Ask instead of guessing
lessons.objective: Ask instead of guessing: Put no before the verb to make a negative.

words.en: Yes, the teacher is arriving soon.
Do you have the class book?
No, today I have a notebook.

words.es: Sí, está cerca de la puerta principal.
words.en: Yes, it is near the main door.

lessons.speaking: Role-play El primer encuentro with a patient classmate. Practice ask instead of guessing. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

grammar.focus: Put no before the verb to make a negative. A yes/no question can use the same words as a statement; intonation and ¿ ? mark it in speech and writing.

examples.es: ¿Es esta la clase de español?
examples.en: Is this the Spanish class?

examples.es: Sí, la profesora llega pronto.
examples.en: Yes, the teacher is arriving soon.

lessons.title: Explain your study routine
lessons.objective: Explain your study routine: Remove -ar and add -o, -as, -a, -amos, -an: hablo, hablas, habla, hablamos, hablan.

words.en: I study Spanish in the afternoon.

words.es: Mi hermana trabaja por la mañana.
words.en: My sister works in the morning.
We practice ten minutes every day.

words.es: Mis amigos estudian conmigo los viernes.
words.en: My friends study with me on Fridays.
I study Spanish in the morning.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Dos horarios with a patient classmate. Practice explain your study routine. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

grammar.focus: Remove -ar and add -o, -as, -a, -amos, -an: hablo, hablas, habla, hablamos, hablan. Match the ending to the subject.

examples.es: Estudio español por la tarde.
examples.en: I study Spanish in the afternoon.

examples.es: Mi hermana trabaja por la mañana.
examples.en: My sister works in the morning.

lessons.title: Read and write a short message
lessons.objective: Read and write a short message: Remove -ir and add -o, -es, -e, -imos, -en.
lessons.focus: Read and write a short message

words.en: I live far from the school.

words.es: Escribimos un mensaje para organizar el viaje.
words.en: We write a message to organize the trip.

words.es: Julia abre el mensaje por la tarde.
words.en: Julia opens the message in the afternoon.

words.es: Recibe mi respuesta antes de la cena.
words.en: She receives my reply before dinner.

words.es: Decidimos ir juntos a la clase.
words.en: We decide to go to class together.
I live in a small city.

words.es: Ana vive cerca de la escuela.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Un mensaje para Julia with a patient classmate. Practice read and write a short message. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

grammar.focus: Remove -ir and add -o, -es, -e, -imos, -en. The nosotros form ends in -imos: vivimos, escribimos.

examples.es: Vivo lejos de la escuela.
examples.en: I live far from the school.

examples.es: Julia vive cerca del parque.
examples.en: Julia lives near the park.

lessons.title: Choose and describe an item
lessons.objective: Choose and describe an item: Adjectives agree with the noun they describe: un libro rojo, unas mochilas rojas.

words.en: I am looking for a small notebook.
There is also a red backpack.
The kind sales assistant helps me.
I am looking for a red backpack.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Una compra pequeña with a patient classmate. Practice choose and describe an item. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

grammar.focus: Adjectives agree with the noun they describe: un libro rojo, unas mochilas rojas. Many adjectives follow the noun; adjectives ending in -e often keep the same gender form.

examples.es: Busco un cuaderno pequeño.
examples.en: I am looking for a small notebook.

examples.es: Esta tienda tiene cuadernos azules.
examples.en: This store has blue notebooks.

lessons.title: Return the right belongings
lessons.objective: Return the right belongings: Possessives agree with what is possessed, not the owner: mi libro, mis libros; tu mesa, tus mesas.

words.es: Mi teléfono está en tu mesa.
words.en: My phone is on your table.

words.es: Tu libro está en mi mochila.
words.en: Your book is in my backpack.

words.es: Mis cuadernos están en la biblioteca.
words.en: My notebooks are in the library.
Ana is looking for her backpack.

words.es: La mochila de Ana está cerca de la puerta.
words.en: Ana's backpack is near the door.

words.es: Mi mochila está en la clase.
words.en: My backpack is in the classroom.

words.es: Mis libros están en mi mochila.
words.en: My books are in my backpack.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Al final de la clase with a patient classmate. Practice return the right belongings. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

grammar.focus: Possessives agree with what is possessed, not the owner: mi libro, mis libros; tu mesa, tus mesas. Su can mean his, her, your formal or their; clarify with de when needed.

examples.es: Mi teléfono está en tu mesa.
examples.en: My phone is on your table.

examples.es: Tu libro está en mi mochila.
examples.en: Your book is in my backpack.

lessons.title: Order around different preferences
lessons.objective: Order around different preferences: With gustar, the liked thing controls the verb: me gusta el libro; me gustan los libros.

words.es: A mí me gusta el café.
A Julia le gusta el té.
A Diego no le gustan las aceitunas.
Nos gusta comer en la plaza.
words.en: We like eating in the square.
Do you like this quiet café?

words.es: A Ana le gustan los libros.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Una merienda juntos with a patient classmate. Practice order around different preferences. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

grammar.focus: With gustar, the liked thing controls the verb: me gusta el libro; me gustan los libros. Use gusta with an infinitive: me gusta leer.

examples.es: A mí me gusta el café.
examples.en: I like coffee.

examples.es: A Julia le gusta el té.
examples.en: Julia likes tea.

lessons.title: Make a plan everyone can do
lessons.objective: Make a plan everyone can do: Poder changes o to ue except in nosotros: puedo, puedes, puede, podemos, pueden.
lessons.focus: Make a plan everyone can do

words.en: I want to go to the museum.

words.es: Julia puede venir por la mañana.
words.en: Julia can come in the morning.

words.es: Diego no puede salir antes de las diez.
words.en: Diego cannot go out before ten.

words.es: Podemos comer después de la visita.
words.en: We can eat after the visit.
We want to walk through the park.
Can you reserve a table for three?

lessons.speaking: Role-play Un sábado libre with a patient classmate. Practice make a plan everyone can do. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

grammar.focus: Poder changes o to ue except in nosotros: puedo, puedes, puede, podemos, pueden. The next verb stays in the infinitive: puedo hablar.

examples.es: Quiero ir al museo.
examples.en: I want to go to the museum.

examples.es: Julia puede venir por la mañana.
examples.en: Julia can come in the morning.

lessons.title: Explain what needs doing
lessons.objective: Explain what needs doing: Necesitar + infinitive expresses a need.

words.es: Tenemos que estudiar para el examen.
words.en: We have to study for the exam.
I need to review the questions.

words.es: Julia tiene que terminar dos páginas.
words.en: Julia has to finish two pages.
We can practice together at home.

words.es: No tenemos que aprender todo hoy.
words.en: We do not have to learn everything today.
I need to review the verbs.
I have to finish the homework.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Preparar un examen with a patient classmate. Practice explain what needs doing. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

grammar.focus: Necesitar + infinitive expresses a need. Tener que + infinitive expresses an obligation: necesito estudiar; tengo que estudiar. Keep que after tener.

examples.es: Tenemos que estudiar para el examen.
examples.en: We have to study for the exam.

examples.es: Necesito repasar las preguntas.
examples.en: I need to review the questions.

lessons.title: Tell a daily routine in order
lessons.objective: Tell a daily routine in order: A reflexive pronoun changes with the person: me, te, se, nos, se.
lessons.focus: Tell a daily routine in order

words.es: Julia se despierta a las seis.
Se levanta y abre la ventana.
words.en: She gets up and opens the window.

words.es: Por la noche se acuesta temprano.
words.en: At night she goes to bed early.

words.es: Yo me acuesto después de estudiar.
words.en: I go to bed after studying.

words.es: Ana se ducha por la mañana.

lessons.speaking: Role-play La mañana de Julia with a patient classmate. Practice tell a daily routine in order. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

grammar.focus: A reflexive pronoun changes with the person: me, te, se, nos, se. In me levanto, the person getting up is also the subject. Put the pronoun before a conjugated verb.

examples.es: Julia se despierta a las seis.
examples.en: Julia wakes up at six.

examples.es: Se levanta y abre la ventana.
examples.en: She gets up and opens the window.

lessons.title: Give directions on campus
lessons.objective: Give directions on campus: Use en for in/on/at as context requires.

words.es: La biblioteca está al lado del café.
words.en: The library is next to the café.

words.es: La sala de estudio está detrás de la biblioteca.
words.en: The study room is behind the library.

words.es: Hay una mesa delante de la ventana.
words.en: There is a table in front of the window.

words.es: Mi mochila está debajo de esa mesa.
words.en: My backpack is under that table.

words.es: La clase está cerca de la puerta principal.
words.en: The classroom is near the main door.

words.es: El parque está lejos de este edificio.
words.en: The park is far from this building.

words.es: La clase está en el segundo piso.
words.en: The classroom is on the second floor.

words.es: La biblioteca está cerca del café.
words.en: The library is near the café.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Ayudar a un visitante with a patient classmate. Practice give directions on campus. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

grammar.focus: Use en for in/on/at as context requires. Cerca de, lejos de, delante de and detrás de locate things. De + el becomes del.

examples.es: La biblioteca está al lado del café.
examples.en: The library is next to the café.

examples.es: La sala de estudio está detrás de la biblioteca.
examples.en: The study room is behind the library.

lessons.title: Separate now from tomorrow
lessons.objective: Separate now from tomorrow: Use a present form of ir + a + infinitive: voy a estudiar.

words.en: Now I am reading at home.

words.es: Mañana vamos a visitar a Diego.
words.en: Tomorrow we are going to visit Diego.

words.es: Después va a comprar un libro.
words.en: Afterward he is going to buy a book.

words.es: Vamos a hablar después de la cena.
words.en: We are going to talk after dinner.
Tomorrow I am going to study Spanish.

words.es: Ana va a comprar un libro.
words.en: Ana is going to buy a book.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Dos momentos with a patient classmate. Practice separate now from tomorrow. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

grammar.focus: Use a present form of ir + a + infinitive: voy a estudiar. This expresses a planned future action. Do not conjugate the second verb.

examples.es: Ahora estoy leyendo en casa.
examples.en: Now I am reading at home.

examples.es: Julia está preparando la cena.
examples.en: Julia is preparing dinner.

lessons.title: Refer back without repeating
lessons.objective: Refer back without repeating: Lo, la, los and las replace a direct object and agree with it: el libro → lo; las llaves → las.

words.es: Ella lo tiene en su mochila.
words.en: She has it in her backpack.

words.es: Le pido el libro después de clase.
words.en: I ask her for the book after class.

words.es: Julia me lo presta por un día.
words.en: Julia lends it to me for one day.
I read it in the library.
Afterward I return the book to her.

words.es: Busco el libro y lo encuentro.
words.en: I look for the book and find it.

words.es: Tengo la mochila y la abro.
words.en: I have the backpack and open it.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Un libro prestado with a patient classmate. Practice refer back without repeating. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

grammar.focus: Lo, la, los and las replace a direct object and agree with it: el libro → lo; las llaves → las. Put the pronoun before a conjugated verb.

examples.es: Necesito el libro de Julia.
examples.en: I need Julia's book.

examples.es: Ella lo tiene en su mochila.
examples.en: She has it in her backpack.

lessons.title: Tell what happened yesterday
lessons.objective: Tell what happened yesterday: The preterite reports completed past actions.

words.es: Terminamos la tarea a las cinco.
words.en: We finished the homework at five.

words.es: Diego compró pan en la tienda.
words.en: Diego bought bread at the store.

words.es: Julia escribió un mensaje a su hermana.
words.en: Julia wrote a message to her sister.
Yesterday I studied in the library.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Una tarde diferente with a patient classmate. Practice tell what happened yesterday. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

grammar.focus: The preterite reports completed past actions. Regular -ar endings include -é, -aste, -ó, -amos, -aron; -er/-ir include -í, -iste, -ió, -imos, -ieron. Written accents matter.

examples.es: Ayer estudié con Julia.
examples.en: Yesterday I studied with Julia.

examples.es: Terminamos la tarea a las cinco.
examples.en: We finished the homework at five.

lessons.title: Contrast a habit and an event
lessons.objective: Contrast a habit and an event: Use the imperfect for past habits or background: estudiaba, comía, vivía.
lessons.focus: Contrast a habit and an event

words.en: I used to live near Julia.
We used to study together on Mondays.
Yesterday I went to her house.
We spoke Spanish for an hour.

words.es: Antes vivía cerca de la escuela.
words.en: I used to live near the school.
I used to study Spanish in the afternoon.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Antes y ayer with a patient classmate. Practice contrast a habit and an event. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

grammar.focus: Use the imperfect for past habits or background: estudiaba, comía, vivía. It presents an ongoing or repeated past situation rather than its completed boundary.

examples.es: Antes vivía cerca de Julia.
examples.en: I used to live near Julia.

examples.es: Estudiábamos juntos los lunes.
examples.en: We used to study together on Mondays.

lessons.title: Spanish 101 final conversation
lessons.objective: Spanish 101 final conversation: Y adds an idea, pero contrasts it, porque explains a reason, and entonces signals a result or next step.

words.es: Soy estudiante y vivo cerca de la escuela.
words.en: I am a student and I live near the school.
Yesterday I studied with my friends.
Today we are preparing for an exam.

words.es: Quiero ir a la biblioteca, pero está cerrada.
words.en: I want to go to the library, but it is closed.

words.es: Podemos estudiar en casa porque tenemos los libros.
words.en: We can study at home because we have the books.

words.es: Mañana vamos a practicar otra vez.
words.en: Tomorrow we are going to practice again.

words.es: Quiero estudiar, pero la biblioteca está cerrada.
words.en: I want to study, but the library is closed.

words.es: Ana tiene un libro y dos cuadernos.
words.en: Ana has a book and two notebooks.

lessons.speaking: Role-play Un cambio de planes with a patient classmate. Practice spanish 101 final conversation. Use this lesson's grammar, ask a related question, answer the partner, and confirm understanding. Keep language at beginner level; explain unfamiliar words in English when asked.

grammar.focus: Y adds an idea, pero contrasts it, porque explains a reason, and entonces signals a result or next step. Join short accurate clauses before trying long sentences.

examples.es: Soy estudiante y vivo cerca de la escuela.
examples.en: I am a student and I live near the school.

examples.es: Ayer estudié con mis amigos.
examples.en: Yesterday I studied with my friends.
